body: A very good animation movie , good scrip , good music if you can watch this movie , go .
Sub culture at its best. Fun & action from the first minute. Extraordinary visual in different styles, very creative. I can not understand mediocre reviews from mainstream media (old men?)
...Everything else is subpar though. The voice acting, the plot, the directing, all need work.

This movie does start off a little Bland but the animations pretty spot-on the American voice overs are not bad. It gets better as it goes on. The plot pending on how much you pay attention can actually be very good with some underlining subjects.

This movie really shows you can throw a bunch of ideas out there and make a movie. It's crazy but it flows and makes sense of course it's not the best animation out there but it is something that entertains you. It doesn't have some big hidden meaning behind it that I can see but I liked how the animation flowed well and the creativity put into this was something out of a dream. Soundtrack is perfect for the scenes they use music and there are a couple Easter eggs like the Men in black MIB on the license plates of the government people. Overall fun movie I would most definitely watch again!
